Chapter 425: Chapter 4: Lin Yuan’s Arrival (Please Subscribe)

“`

“Greetings to the Galaxy Master!”

“Greetings to the Galaxy Master!!”

“Greetings to the Galaxy Master!!!”

Lin Yuan stepped out of the spaceship, facing the countless Evolvers who bowed respectfully and knelt down to him.

His mindset began to shift slightly.

...

On the Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan had supreme power, and numerous Evolvers showed him the utmost respect,

but it all stemmed from the title of Chikun Star Lord.

Now, however, these Evolvers were bowing to him as the Galaxy Master, to him, Lin Yuan.

“Rise.”

Lin Yuan said.

“Yes.”

The two leading Evolvers, one in a purple robe and the other with a head of golden hair, straightened with reverence.

“You two must be Chun Bo and Jia Li, correct?” Lin Yuan looked at them both.

After confirming his position as Galaxy Master, Lin Yuan had received plenty of information, including details about Chun Bo and Jia Li.

These two were specifically left behind by human civilization to help him take complete control over the Milky Way Star Region.

Despite not being comparable to the two Eighth Rank members of a Different Species that his teacher gave him, they were both Seventh Rank Evolvers.

“Yes.”

“I am honored that the Star Lord remembers our names.”

Chun Bo and Jia Li replied with respect.

“Alright, disperse them all now.” Lin Yuan looked towards the dense crowd of Evolvers behind them.

“Yes.”

Chun Bo nodded, turned to face the large army, and announced, “The Star Lord orders you all to disperse.”

His voice quickly reached the ears of every Evolver.

“Yes.”

“By the will of the esteemed Star Lord.”

The large army of Evolvers promptly dispersed in an orderly fashion.

“Star Lord, let me introduce you to the main star…” Chun Bo immediately said.

The Milky Way Main Star was vast, and although Lin Yuan had received relevant data in advance, it was impossible for everything about such a large star to be recorded.

After roughly touring the main star, Chun Bo and Jia Li led Lin Yuan into a magnificent palace.

“The B-level modification of the planet is almost complete, isn’t it?” Lin Yuan asked.

The modification of the Milky Way Main Star began as soon as Lin Yuan paid a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals. The nearby Star Alliance’s Evolvers hurried over and then started the transformation.

“Yes.”

“The planet modification is entering the final phase and is about to conclude,” Chun Bo immediately replied.

The stronger the Planetary Defense System on the main star, the safer it was, and this gave Lin Yuan a sense of confidence and reassurance.

“That’s quite fast.” Lin Yuan nodded.

Aside from the travel time, the planet’s modification had been ongoing for at most three to four years.

In such a short time, to have transformed this planet into a ‘forbidden area’ capable of easily suppressing most Eighth Rank Evolvers, was no small feat.

“Who would dare not exert their full effort when working for the Star Lord?” remarked Jia Li from beside him.

The position of Galaxy Master was not merely a typical Star Lord; not only was he the disciple of Chikun Star Lord, but he was also a top-tier genius with limitless potential from human civilization.

The workers surely put in all their effort for the modification of his main star, not daring to slack off in the slightest.

Of course, the main reason was that Lin Yuan had paid enough, a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, of which the workers could also receive a share.

“I have two subordinates who will assist you with the management of the main star,” Lin Yuan said, looking at Jia Li and Chun Bo.

The two from a Different Species gifted by the Chikun Star Lord, Hongpi and the one with blue eyes, were not only Eighth Rank, but also possessed extensive experience in managing planets.

Managing a planet well, especially the main star that serves as the economic and political center of a Star Domain, required a significant degree of steering capability.

“Alright.”

Chun Bo and Jia Li had no objections.

For Lin Yuan, who was taking control of a new Star Domain for the first time, to place his trustworthy subordinates was perfectly normal.

If Lin Yuan did not place his own people and trusted them completely, it would be Chun Bo and Jia Li who would feel anxious.

…

Inner World.

Hongpi and the one with blue eyes, both Eighth Rank members of a Different Species, had completely numbed themselves.

Five years.

Just five years.

For them, such a span was not even enough for a nap.

Yet under the watchful eyes of the two Eighth Rank beings, Lin Yuan’s Inner World had exploded from nearly 300,000 miles in circumference before his departure to 700,000 miles.

It had expanded by a full 400,000 miles.

Is this even human?

Hongpi and the one with blue eyes steadied themselves, trying to recover from the shock.

Originally, they speculated whether Lin Yuan, newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, reached nearly 300,000 miles in his Inner World by relying on some space-related Rare Treasure.

Some treasures hidden deep in the Cosmic Starry Skies were of great help in crafting an Inner World, although there were many thresholds to using these treasures.

At least it could somewhat explain how Lin Yuan’s Inner World reached nearly 300,000 miles when he first advanced to the Eighth Rank.

But the events of the past five years had undoubtedly shattered the cognition of the two members of the Eighth Rank Alien Race.

They watched step by step as Lin Yuan’s Inner World expanded daily, monthly, and yearly, until it reached the current circumference of 700,000 miles.

Using some spatial treasures to boost the size of one’s Inner World upon its initial creation was imaginable.

But to keep expanding after that would depend solely on one’s comprehension of the Space Rules.

In other words, Lin Yuan’s expansion in the past five years was purely based on his understanding of the Space Rules.

An Inner World of 700,000 miles in circumference…

Hongpi and the one with blue eyes forced themselves to remain calm.

They had seen Inner Worlds of 700,000 miles; the Chikun Star Lord’s Inner World was even much larger.

However, to soar from nearly 300,000 miles to nearly 700,000 miles in just five years…

This was unheard of for them.

Even the favorite child of the spatial Origin Source, the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, born with its own Inner World, could not possibly have such freakish growth in its core spatial model comprehension.
